reports.title: Dolby Laboratories Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Dolby is providing the following estimates for its first quarter of fiscal 2027:
• | Total revenue is expected to range from $285 million to $305 million.
• | Licensing revenue is expected to range from $260 million to $280 million.
• | Gross margins are anticipated to be approximately 85% on a GAAP basis and approximately 87% on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Operating expenses are anticipated to range from $240 million to $250 million on a GAAP basis and from $200 million to $210 million on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Effective tax rate is anticipated to be around 23% on a GAAP basis and around 21% on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Diluted earnings per share is anticipated to range from $0.01 to $0.16 on a GAAP basis and from $0.41 to $0.56 on a non-GAAP basis.
Dolby is providing the following estimates for the full year of fiscal 2027:
• | Total revenue is expected to be roughly flat at approximately $1.42 billion.
• | Licensing revenue is expected to be roughly flat at approximately $1.32 billion.
• | Gross margins are anticipated to be approximately 87% on a GAAP basis and approximately 89% on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Operating expenses are anticipated to be roughly flat at approximately $925 million on a GAAP basis and approximately $775 million on a non-GAAP basis.

desk.headline: Revenue up 22% to $374m, beat; FY27 outlook flat at about $1.42bn
results: Q4 revenue rose 22% to $374m, driven by licensing revenue of $347m (+23%).
Non-GAAP EPS was $1.25 (vs $0.99); GAAP EPS rose to $0.86 from $0.51.
For the full year revenue grew 5% to $1.42bn and non-GAAP operating margin improved about 130 bps to 34.5%.
Dolby bought back 1.1m shares for about $65m in Q4 ($265m for the year) and declared a $0.39 quarterly dividend.

guidance.summary: Dolby expects fiscal 2027 revenue roughly flat at about $1.42bn, with non-GAAP EPS of $4.27-4.42 (FY26: $4.36). Q1 revenue is guided to $285-305m.

watch: Whether licensing revenue can grow in FY27 against a flat outlook.
Priorities of new CEO Marc Whitten (joined August), including AI and simplifying the business.
Investor event at CES on 7 January 2027.
